Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! Yastika Bhatia and Shafali Verma are the openers. Fatima Sana takes strike.
... RUN CHASE ...

India will be disappointed with the finish! They will feel they have let Pakistan away and now face a stiff task ahead! They were really good with the new ball and for most of the part in the middle overs. The likes of Radha Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Renuka Singh were good in the initial part but later on conceded far too many runs. The fielding was not upto the mark too. It is onto their batters now. They do have a strong batting line-up and the wicket seems decent to bat on. Can they chase it down? Pakistan on the other hand, will back their bowlers to defend this. The chase in a bit. Stay tuned.

That is a brilliant, brilliant recovery from Pakistan Women! Let me remind you they were four down for 68 and at one stage were going below 6 per over. Bismah Maroof held fort at one end but failed to get support from the other. She got it though through Ayesha Naseem who played a top knock! She came out with intent and really struck a few meaty blows. Bismah Maroof played along her merry way. The two added 81 in no time and have got Pkaistan to a par total.
A dot to end then but a good last over too! On middle, this is jammed back to the bowler. Pakistan Women END WITH 149!
Bismah Maroof makes room! She is followed, she swings, it goes off the inside edge and then hits the keeper's pad. Rolls on the leg side for one.
FOUR! That is exquisite! Just wonderful! A full toss, she just places it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Deepti fires it in this time, a yorker on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
DROPPED AND SIX! Not an easy chance! Ayesha Naseem steps out, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it down the ground. Harmanpreet Kaur leaps but can't hang on. She ends up tipping it over the ropes.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit towards mid off for one.
Just the one to end! Fired into the pads, this is worked down to long on for one.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! Tossed up outside off, Ayesha Naseem comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. She still goes ahead with the shot. Ends up hitting it high up in the air towards long off. Radha Yadav drops it. A single.
Bismah Maroof now steps out and hits it hard but straight to cover for only one.
FOUR! Carved away! This is a top knock from Bismah Maroof! This is tossed up outside off, she carves it past point and into the fence. Another good over this is turning out to be.
Two more! Tossed up on middle, this is lofted down the ground for two.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one. Another good over for Pakistan.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, a slower one. Ayesha Naseem looks to go big but misses.
On the pads, Bismah Maroof looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Two! Another couple! This is fuller and on off, it is hit past mid off. Long on runs to her right and does well to stop it. Two taken.
Two more! Another top shot! This is full and outside off, Bismah Maroof gets down on one knee and hits it over covers for two.

FOUR! EDGY! Fifty for Bismah Maroof too! Top knock! The skipper leading from the front! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Bismah Maroof loooks to defend, it goes off the outside edge and down to third man for a boundary.
This is on middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
On off, this is hit over cover for one.
Another two! Shorter and on middle, this is lofted down to long on for two.
A single as this is pushed towards long off.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to long on.
Two again! Really good running! Fuller and on off, Naseem lifts it over cover for two more.
WIDE! Another one well wide outside off, Naseem slashes but misses. This is turning out to be a long and an expensive over.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for a quick run.
On off, this is guided through point for one.
Another one very wide outside off, Naseem looks to go over covers but misses.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, Naseem swings but misses.
FOUR! Thumped down the ground, this is a really good cameo from Ayesha Naseem but she needs to go on! Fuller and on off, this is hit hard down the ground for a boundary.
SIX! That is some hit! Wow! This is full and outside off, Ayesha Naseem lofts it down the ground, over the long off fence for a biggie. Top shot.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Angled into the pads, Maroof works it through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one more.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On off, this is hit towards cover for one more.
On off, this is hit wide of long off for two.
Two more! Shortish and on middle, this is lofted down the ground for two.
Another single as this is eased down to long on.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one more.
On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Outside off, within the tramline. Naseem swings but misses again.
WIDE! Well outside off, Naseem swings but misses.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller and on off, this is lofted over mid off and it races away to the fence.
A single as this is worked through square leg.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A single as this is worked through square leg.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, it is cut through point for twp.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
OUT! TAKEN! That is a good catch! The reverse sweep comes out. This is outside off, it goes off the glove and to the keeper.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Out comes the sweep again, this time it is nailed behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
The sweep comes out, it is hit through square leg for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Outside off, Bismah looks to cut but is beaten.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut but to point for one.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Two! On off, this is lofted over covers for two.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for no runs.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another one on off, Sidra Ameen pushes it to covers.
On off, this is blocked.
On off, this is pushed towards cover.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Well fielded! Fuller and on middle, this is punched down the ground to the left of mid on. The fielder runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to two.
On off, this is played towards point.
On the stumps, Sidra Ameen pushes it to covers for one.
A single now as this is pushed through cover.
WIDE! A bumper but down the leg side. Wided.
Shorter and on off, this is guided through point for another single.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for another run.
On middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, defended.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Sidra slashes but misses.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
WIDE! Goes short again but down the leg side. Wided.

REVIEW TIME! A huge appeal for a caught behind but turned down. It is reviewed. OUT! ULTRA EDGE SHOWS A SPIKE! That is a huge wicket! Nida Dar who played a brilliant knock the last time these two sides faced, is taking a long walk back. This is short and down the leg side. Nida Dar looks to pull, an appeal but not given. A really good review. Pakistan in a spot of bother now.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
That is a top nut! Length and around off, this one takes off after landing. Bismah Maroof looks to push at it but is beaten.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.

OUT! STUMPED! Timely wicket as this stand was really going along nicely! Muneeba Ali this time looks to step out again but gave the charge a little too early. This is fired outside off. She slashes but misses and the keeper does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Now walks in and then steps out, gets way too close to the pitch of the ball, it is pushed to cover.
Really moving around the crease are the Pakistan batters! Muneeba Ali walks across and then looks to sweep this ball from outside off. She misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter and on middle, Muneeba Ali makes room and lofts it over cover for two.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.

FOUR! That is a wonderfu stroke! The Powerplay ends with a boundary and Pakistan have done well after the loss of an early wicket. On middle, the slog sweep comes out, it is hit over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Makes room, this is tossed up on middle, it is guided to point.
Two! Overthrow! On off, this is guided towards short third man. They taken one. The throw is a wild one at the bowler's end. No one backing up. Another run taken.
Another single! On off, this is hit through covers for one.
Slower through the air and outside off, Ali looks to sweep but misses.
Two dots in a row to end! On off, defended.
Flatter and on middle, Maroof pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! This is nailed! That is some shot! On middle, this is swept hard through square leg and it races away to the fence.
Two more! On off, shorter, the reverse sweep comes out, it is played fine on the off side for two.
Flatter and on off, defended.
Another one on the shorter side, this is pushed through covers for one. This is a good start for Pakistan.
Slower through the air this time and on the pads. Bismah Maroof looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.

FOUR! Swept and swept hard! Two boundaries in a row and this is turning out to be a good over for Pakistan. The sweep shot comes out. She gets on top of the bounce, keeps it down and hits it through square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! That is a top shot. Bismah Maroof steps out and gets to the pitch of it, hits it over the bowler's head for another boundary.
On off, flatter, this is pushed to covers.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one more.
Shorter and on off, this is hit through covers for one.
Another single as this is guided through point.
Now out comes the paddle scoop, it is played towards short fine leg for one.
Shorter and on middle, Maroof pulls it towards mid-wicket for one.
Around off, this is guided to point.
On the stumps, blocked.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Shorter and on off, this is guided through point for one.
Tossed up on off, ths is pushed to covers.

OUT! TAKEN! That is straight to the fielder and India strike early! Not the best of balls but Deepti Sharma won't care! Short and down the leg side. Javeria Khan looks to pull, it goes off the top edge and straight to the fielder at short fine leg.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up on off, Javeria Khan plays it fine on the off side and this one races away to the fence.
Two more! On middle, this one turns back in. Javeria Khan plays the paddle scoop fine on the leg side for two.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Two! On the pads, Javeria Khan works it fine on the leg side. Two taken.
Length and on off, this one moves away. Javeria Khan looks to defend, it goes off the outer half to point.
Pakistan and Muneeba Ali are underway! Length and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
BEATEN! Lovely nut! Length and around off, it lands and moves away. Muneeba Ali looks to poke at it but is beaten.
Right on the money to begin with! On a length and around off, this is blocked.

The two teams make their way out to the middle for their National Anthems! Pakistan will sing first and then it will be India's turn! DONE AND DUSTED WITH THE ANTHEMS! Now it is time for the action to begin! The Indian players make their way out to the middle and they are followed by the Pakistan openers, Javeria Khan and Muneeba Ali! Renuka Singh to start.
Pakistan Women (PLAYING XI) - Javeria Khan, Muneeba Ali (WK), Bismah Maroof (C), Nida Dar, Sidra Ameen, Aliya Riaz, Ayesha Naseem, Fatima Sana, Aiman Anwer, Nashra Sandhu, Sadia Iqbal.

India Women (PLAYING XI) - Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harleen Deol, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Radha Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh.

Harmanpreet Kaur says she wanted to bat first too as these wickets are tricky but they now need to do well. Informs Smriti Mandhana will be fine for the first game. Adds Harleen Deol comes in as they want to play an extra batter. Ends by saying they just need to do the right work and she hopes the wickets help them.

Bismah Maroof says it seems a dry wicket and they want to put a good total on the board. Adds they are well prepared and will look to put their best foot forward. Also says they are confident heading into the game.
TOSS - Pakistan Women have won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT!

Quite a few times in recent times these two countries have played their first game of a major tournament against each other. Now, we are also considering men's cricket. However, there, the teams are quite even, here though, India are far too superior to Pakistan. India are a force reckon especially in this format and are one of the favourites to go till the finals in this compeition. Pakistan however, managed to beat the Indians the last time the two sides played which was in the Asia Cup. India though will probably have that in mind and will be rearing for revenge. Can Pakistan upset the odds yet again?

It is now time for the high-octane clash between India Women and Pakistan Women at the ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2023 at Newlands in Cape Town. India Women were the finalists in the previous edition of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup, and they will be looking to go one step further this time around. Their archrivals, Pakistan Women, were knocked out at the group stage, and they will be eager to put up a better show this time around. As part of the preparations for the competition, India Women were pitted against Australia and Bangladesh in their official warm-up games. They suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of Australia but bounced back with a convincing victory over Bangladesh. India Women were dealt a major blow in their preparations for the first game as left-handed batter Smriti Mandhana was ruled out after failing to recover in time from a finger injury. In her absence, the onus will be on Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues and skipper Harmanpreet Kaur to deliver the goods with the bat. The return of Shikha Pandey has strengthened India’s pace attack, and she will have Renuka Singh and Anjali Sarvani for support. They also have a good mix of spinners to rely on in the form of Devika Vaidya, Deepti Sharma, and Rajeshwari Gayakwad. On the other hand, Pakistan Women won their first warm-up game against Bangladesh but suffered a defeat in their second warm-up game against South Africa. In the batting department, they will be dependent on their ever-reliable skipper Bismah Maroof, Javeria Khan, Sidra Ameen, and Muneeba Ali. In the pace department, Fatima Sana, Aliya Riaz, and Aiman Anwer will be crucial for them, whereas the spinners Nida Dar, Sadia Iqbal, and Nashra Sandhu will also need to come to the party. India Women have the upper hand, winning 10 out of the previous 13 meetings between the two sides, but in the most recent meeting, it was Pakistan Women who came out on top. Which team will start their ICC Women's T20 World Cup 2023 campaign on a winning note? We shall find out together.
